findings.claim: 10-K 自述：Apple 在全球智慧型手機、PC、平板、穿戴市場均為少數份額（minority market share），並警告 AI 能力若落後可能流失份額。
findings.excerpt: The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall.

findings.claim: 10-K 自述：競爭對手以激進定價與極低成本結構競爭並模仿產品，部分對手可近乎無利潤甚至虧損銷售。
findings.excerpt: Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss.

findings.claim: Counterpoint：2026Q3 蘋果全球智慧型手機份額升至約22%，為首個Q3超過20%，整體市場年減。
IDC：2026Q3 全球PC出貨年減20.1%，Mac出貨年減11.3%但份額由8.5%升至9.5%。
findings.excerpt: data, Apple shipped 5.9 million Macs during Q3 2026, down 11.3% from 6.7 million in the year-ago period. The overall PC market, however, fell much more sharply, with worldwide shipments dropping 20.1% year over year to 62.7 million units. As a result, Apple’s share of worldwide PC shipments actually increased from 8.5% to 9.5%.

findings.claim: IDC：2026Q3 中國智慧型手機市場年減15.4%，華為21.1%居首，蘋果17.8%（去年同期15.8%）。
findings.excerpt: Apple gains ground as China’s smartphone shipments plunge 15.4% In a new report released today, IDC says that rising component costs and retail prices continue to weigh on the broader Chinese smartphone market. According to IDC, Apple accounted for 17.8% of smartphone shipments in China during Q3 2026, up from 15.8% in the year-ago period.

note: 以下份額數據來自搜尋摘要的二手轉述，未取得可逐字原文，放 clues 待程式核實：Counterpoint 2026Q3 全球手機份額22%（市場年減20%）；IDC 2026Q3 Mac出貨-11.3%但份額8.5%→9.5%；IDC 2026Q3 中國蘋果17.8%（去年15.8%），華為21.1%領先。 線索 3 條，程式核實 2 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
